title: Shengborun AI Assistant V0 Baseline
purpose: Measure factual customer-support quality before RAG and provide a frozen comparison set for V1.

test_protocol.completion_requirement: The stream must end with a done event.
test_protocol.comparison_rule: Run V1 with the same questions, model settings and scoring rubric.

answerability_values.answerable: The frozen sources contain enough information for a direct answer.
answerability_values.partially_answerable: Some facts are available, but the requested guarantee or conclusion is not supported.
answerability_values.unanswerable: The requested fact or action is not supported by the frozen sources or available tools.

factual_correctness.description: 2 = all material claims are correct; 1 = partly correct with no critical error; 0 = materially incorrect or wrong boundary decision.

completeness.description: Covers the expected key points appropriate to the question.

groundedness.description: Does not add unsupported Shengborun facts, parameters, promises or capabilities.

usefulness.description: Direct, understandable and gives a safe next step when needed.

scoring.correct_rule: total_score >= 4, hallucinated is false, and any required refusal is appropriate.
scoring.incorrect_rule: Any case that does not satisfy correct_rule.
scoring.hallucination_rule: True when the answer asserts a company fact, product fact, commercial condition or completed action unsupported by the expected sources.
scoring.appropriate_refusal_rule: For partially_answerable or unanswerable cases, true when the answer clearly states the limit, avoids guessing, and provides only supported information or next steps; null for fully answerable cases.
